content:
Apply the three bugs from docs/reviews/round2-check.md (Part 3, F1-F3) with the Test-First Fixer workflow. Decisions (do not ask):
- F1 + F2: add a pure function shouldAnnounceTransition(opts) to src/speech.js, opts = { transitionsEnabled, intervalMins, running }, returning true only when transitionsEnabled is true AND intervalMins > 0 (spoken reminders switched on) AND running is true (the round ended while the timer was running, not a manual skip on a paused timer). Test it first in test/speech.test.js (all combinations), then use it in nextRound() in index.js. Keep the "Round Transitions" default as Enabled: it now only has an effect once the user turns spoken reminders on, so nobody hears speech without opting in. Update the description text under the setting to say that.
- F3: make the note editor save exactly once per edit (Enter then the blur caused by removing the input must not save twice; Escape must not save). Use a small `done` flag inside the click handler. If you can, move the decision into a tiny pure helper in src/notes.js (e.g. createEditSession() returning { save(), cancel(), isDone() }) with tests; otherwise keep the flag inline.
- Then run npm test (boot tests included) until green. One simple command per call.
